title: Software Development Engineer 2 (SDE 2)
description:
Own a cross-org initiative automating operational ticket investigation with AI agents, built on three layers: an operational memory that clusters past tickets by symptom and root cause to generate agentic skills from SOPs, a semantic code graph that makes codebases agent-friendly, and a knowledge layer of wikis, code reviews, and design docs.
Validated generated skills against a holdout set with an actor–critic loop, reaching 90% accuracy on holdout tickets; skills are discovered dynamically at runtime across teams. Live for 3 teams (30+ engineers) and expanding to multiple orgs, cutting root-cause time from 30–60 minutes to ~10 minutes across 1,200+ tickets a year.
Spearheaded the infrastructure for World Catalog, Amazon's pioneering agent-first global catalog. Engineered data systems to ingest and harmonize products beyond the Amazon ecosystem, powering next-generation AI search tools.
Architected the Progressive Listing Experience (PLE), integrating LLMs to autonomously scrape and map external seller URLs to the complex Amazon catalog schema, drastically reducing seller onboarding friction.
Led a ground-up architecture rewrite of the catalog contribution ingestion pipeline to support asynchronous LLM workflows and improve end-to-end traceability and security, while overhauling the CI/CD infrastructure to reduce build times by over 80%.
Designed and launched 3 net-new microservices utilizing a highly extensible plugin architecture for catalog data validation, creating an execution engine with over 200 custom rules for marketplace translation and image enrichment.

title: SDE Intern, Item Pipeline
description:
Engineered a custom Code Analyzer to automate bug detection and enforce strict coding standards, directly improving organizational code quality and reducing operational burden.
Successfully championed the tool's integration into the CI/CD pipelines of 8 distinct teams, achieving widespread adoption by over 100 active engineers.
Architected and deployed scalable, secure serverless microservices for the Item Pipeline utilizing Java, TypeScript, AWS Lambda, Amazon SNS, and VPCs.
